title: Your whole job in one account
intro: ELT Suite is made by English teachers, for English teachers. The board, the coursebook, the worksheets and your marking pen are all in one place, online:
benefits: Plan in minutes. Write a lesson like a document, with questions that mark themselves, sound and pronunciation inside.
Teach it live. Every learner’s screen follows yours, in class or online, and you see their answers as they come in.
Print it beautifully. Any lesson becomes a worksheet that looks like a coursebook page.
See who needs help. Answers, marking and attendance in one place, with a recap for learners afterwards.
